mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_command (command_id, user_id, scope_key, idempotency_key, payload_hash, task_id, binding_id, scope_id, action, payload_json, status, due_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{userId}, #{scopeKey}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadHash}, #{taskId}, #{bindingId}, (SELECT scope_id FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId}), 'SUBMIT', #{payloadJson}, 'PENDING', #{dueAt})

INSERT INTO sq_command (command_id, user_id, scope_key, idempotency_key, payload_hash, task_id, binding_id, scope_id, action, payload_json, status, due_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{userId}, #{scopeKey}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadHash}, #{taskId}, #{bindingId}, (SELECT scope_id FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId}), #{action}, #{payloadJson}, 'PENDING', #{dueAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_command SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DELIVERING')
mapper.select: SELECT command_id, user_id, task_id, binding_id, payload_hash, status, native_turn_id, native_run_id, native_status FROM sq_command WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT command_id, user_id, task_id, binding_id, payload_hash, status, native_turn_id, native_run_id, native_status FROM sq_command WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT command_id, user_id, task_id, binding_id, payload_hash, status, native_turn_id, native_run_id, native_status FROM sq_command WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND command_id = #{commandId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_command SET status = 'APPLIED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND native_turn_id = #{turnId} AND status = 'DELIVERED' AND action IN ('SUBMIT', 'MASTER_SIGNAL', 'TASK_DIRECTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_command c JOIN sq_runtime_binding b ON b.user_id = c.user_id AND b.binding_id = c.binding_id AND b.role = 'MASTER' WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.task_id = #{taskId} AND c.action IN ('SUBMIT', 'MASTER_SIGNAL', 'TASK_DIRECTIVE') AND c.status IN ('PENDING', 'DELIVERING', 'DELIVERED')

SELECT command_id FROM sq_command WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND action = 'SUBMIT' AND status IN ('DELIVERED', 'APPLIED') AND native_turn_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
